# LUSOTEC SPA

LUSOTEC SPA is a Chilean company specializing in chemical products, technical advice and solutions for the leather and tanning industry.

Main solution areas:
- Beamhouse & Pretanning
- Retanning, Syntans & Tannins
- Fatliquors
- Dyes
- Finishing & Auxiliaries
- Collagen & Derivatives
- Technical Advice

Finishing solutions include:
- Acrylics
- Polyurethanes
- Auxiliaries
- Pigments

Official website:
https://www.lusotec.cl/
